checks.message: Boundary is explicitly provisional, medium-confidence, and never presented as a statutory redline.
All three required areas are present and explicitly labeled as provisional rough envelopes.
Six concept land-use polygons form a non-overlapping full partition of the submitted provisional site envelope.
Chinese and English visual pages are static, offline, and use only local generated assets.
The proposal links design claims to sources, standards, design depth, GeoJSON, metrics, assumptions, and matrices.
Chinese and English proposal, figures, HTML, visual page, and drawing counterparts are present.
Twelve concept scenarios identify human lead, consent or privacy boundary, non-digital fallback, and stop or appeal condition.
No fieldwork, stakeholder commitment, approval, procurement, or implementation claim is made.
All diagrams are generated from repository data and original vector composition; external images, logos, and map tiles are excluded.
